decisions.D1: Arabic-name lockups WITHDRAWN. Every lockup that typeset «سراج للتطوير العقاري» in Tajawal (Horizontal, Stacked, Arabic-led; all colours) is archived in 99-Archive/Withdrawn/Arabic-Name-Lockups. The official English artwork is the brand mark; the Descriptor lockup stays. The registered Arabic name appears only as normal legal/administrative text where required, never as a logo or substitute lockup.
decisions.D2: Vector silk KEPT as SPECIAL PRODUCTION / RESTRICTED USE: vinyl cutting, embroidery, special printing, fabrication, plotter/cutting workflows and other cases that technically require vectors. It never replaces the realistic pressed-maroon silk in normal marketing visuals.
decisions.D3: Dark border-strong = #8C6B64 in both token sets (09-Design-System tokens + platform exports regenerated). #7A5A55 had no consumer and no distinct role, so it was retired rather than kept as a third border level.
decisions.D4: Project name REMAINS POSTPONED. No project-name lettering is created, designed or restored.
decisions.D5: Missing legal/project data stays unresolved. «—» exists only in editable/internal templates; every publish-ready export hides an unresolved field (doc runtime ?export, social publish briefs) instead of showing a placeholder, dash or invented value.
decisions.D6: Ribbon key visual re-graded (colour only) to the family grade with tools/siraj-warmth-match.py --strength 1.4: warm environment 16.3 % → 2.5 %, yellow light 1.6 % → 0 %; composition unchanged; derived posts, stories, slide and carousel rebuilt.
